title: Sheep reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='36' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- sheep body (cloud of wool) -->
  <g fill='#F5F0E6'>
    <circle cx='32' cy='62' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='15'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='63' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='14'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wool shading blobs -->
  <g fill='#E0D8C8'>
    <circle cx='38' cy='72' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#8D6E63'/>
  <rect x='56' y='76' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#8D6E63'/>
  <rect x='38' y='85' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <rect x='56' y='85' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#F5F0E6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='30' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#E0D8C8' transform='rotate(-20 34 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#E0D8C8' transform='rotate(20 66 30)'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#F8E2C8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='2.2' fill='#3B3B4F'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='2.2' fill='#3B3B4F'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='30.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='30.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#C98B7A'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#C98B7A'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='translate(28 44) rotate(-8)'>
    <rect x='0' y='0' width='44' height='30' rx='3' fill='#E53935'/>
    <rect x='0' y='0' width='44' height='30' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#B71C1C' stroke-width='2'/>
    <rect x='2' y='2' width='40' height='26' rx='2' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='2' x2='22' y2='28' stroke='#B71C1C' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- text lines left page -->
    <g stroke='#90A4AE' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <line x1='5' y1='8' x2='19' y2='8'/>
      <line x1='5' y1='13' x2='19' y2='13'/>
      <line x1='5' y1='18' x2='16' y2='18'/>
    </g>
    <!-- text lines right page -->
    <g stroke='#90A4AE' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <line x1='25' y1='8' x2='39' y2='8'/>
      <line x1='25' y1='13' x2='39' y2='13'/>
      <line x1='25' y1='18' x2='36' y2='18'/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <!-- hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='55' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8D6E63'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='55' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8D6E63'/>
</svg>
